name: Yearly County-Level Counts
description: Yearly county-level dataset of hospitalizations, mortality, and demographic statistics for Medicare beneficiaries, including death counts and population characteristics.

content.n_bene: Int64: Number of beneficiaries in County
content.n_dead: Double: Number of deaths in County in given year
content.female_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries that are female
content.dual_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with dual Medicaid enrollment
content.age_65_75_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with age [65, 75]
content.age_76_85_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with age (75, 85]
content.age_86_95_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with age (85, 95]
content.age_96_105_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with age (96, 105]
content.age_106_115_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with age (106,115]
content.race_black_pct: Double: Percent of Black or African American beneficiaries
content.race_hispanic_pct: Double: Percent of Hispanic or Latino beneficiaries
content.race_asian_pct: Double: Percent of Asian or Asian American beneficiaries
content.race_rti_unknown_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with unknown race (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_white_pct: Double: Percent of Non-Hispanic White beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_black_pct: Double: Percent of Non-Hispanic Black beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_other_pct: Double: Percent of Other race beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_asian_pct: Double: Percent of Non-Hispanic Asian beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_hispanic_pct: Double: Percent of Hispanic beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_ai_an_pct: Double: Percent of Non-Hispanic American Indian/Alaska Native beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
